posts.t:
Cole Knuble is legit. Dan Vladar is back in peak form. And the Flyers, suddenly, can't seem to lose.
allphly.com/flyers/flyer...
Flyers win 3-1, and they've now won three straight. Cole Knuble and Dan Vladar were the stars of this one.
Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen leads the Sabres out for warmup. Dan Vladar leads the way for the Flyers.
Dan Vladar in goal tonight for the Flyers, coach Rick Tocchet said.
